title: Luenberger Observer
text: Discrete-time Luenberger observer, 2 inputs, 1 output; {State-space parameterization}, {Discrete A matrix} sets a matrix in discrete time, {Discrete B matrix} sets the b matrix in discrete time, {Discrete C matrix} sets the c matrix in discrete time, {Discrete D matrix} sets the d matrix in discrete time, {Continuous A matrix} sets a matrix in continuous time, {Continuous B matrix} sets the b matrix in continuous time, {Continuous C matrix} sets the c matrix in continuous time, {Continuous D matrix} sets the d matrix in continuous time, {Observer design} sets the state-space parameterization Desired, {Observer gain}, {Desired eigenvalues} sets the observer eigenvalues, {Initial conditions}, {Discretization sample time} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Discrete A matrix
params.values: A matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete B matrix
params.values: B matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete C matrix
params.values: C matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete D matrix
params.values: D matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous A matrix
params.values: A matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous B matrix
params.values: B matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous C matrix
params.values: C matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous D matrix
params.values: D matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Observer design
params.values: State-space parameterization Desired eigenvalues (default) | Observer gain

params.name: Observer gain

params.name: Initial conditions

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time 0.1 (default) | -1 or positive real number
